title: Entitled Drunk Lady Thinks She's Above the Law - Most Uncooperative Passenger!
description:
On January 28th, 2023, at 11:16 pm, officers pulled over a vehicle to investigate the driver for possible DWI. During the investigation, an officer questioned the vehicle's passenger, who appeared very intoxicated and would not prove her ID to officers.

The suspect was arrested and later charged with 2 x counts of Battery Upon a Peace Officer and 2 x counts of Disorderly Conduct.
